resolution: Confirmed this is expected under the current saved-paint design: program paintings embed each shader ink's WGSL recipe, and applying the program re-bakes that recipe to a 256x256 texture. The 731 KB module is the assembled fill/material shader. The effect pipeline is cached process-wide by exact WGSL source and bind-group layout, so the same painting/source should compile at most once in one running host; a historical painting can embed a different older shader source and legitimately incur its own first compile. The reported percentage is only elapsed time divided by the previous size-scaled machine baseline, because the blocking driver API exposes no real progress. This compile completed in 26.862s and refreshed the baseline at 749016 bytes, so ending near 31% means it beat the old roughly 84s estimate, not that compilation stopped early. The empty rangetrace messages and ~80ms JS ticks are separate temporary model-load diagnostics/GC churn.
